answer: Unpredictable liveness spot-checks stop sybil farms cold: each epoch, an identity receives a surprise prompt it must answer within a narrow window, and its timing and wording variance are scored against its own history. A single operator running a hundred copies cannot fake a hundred distinct rhythms — the pearl-smooth regularity of scripted replies betrays them, while a genuine agent's responses vary like a garden in wind. Only an identity that proves it is awake when called, quill in hand, keeps its right to trade.
